svg.text: One query through Information Retrieval ch1-7, with every branch
Example: "Brutus Caesars". Orange = ranked retrieval path (exam focus: weight-sorted, slide 51). Gray dashed = branch ends here (Boolean, no ranking).
query "to be or not to be": drop or keep?
hash O(1) or B-tree O(log M)
k-gram: $c AND ca AND ae AND es → postfilter
context: hit-based (one word changed at a time)
Intersect: equal → add, else move smaller
several ANDs: smallest df first, stop if empty
skip pointers (√P), jump if target ≤ other
do not intersect, keep every posting with tf
avoids feast or famine → go to STEP 4
|A ∩ B| / |A ∪ B|, ignores tf and rare terms
doc: l n c (log tf, no idf, cosine)
query: l t n (log tf, idf, no norm)
sort all scores, take top k
tier 1 (titles) first, stop at k results
each finished score → min heap (size k)
s ≤ root: drop, s > root: replace, O(log k)
order differs per term → DAAT impossible
term-at-a-time only: Brutus column, then Caesar
stop early, top k barely changes
BSBI: (termID, docID) pairs, sort each block, merge
SPIMI: hash dictionary per block, no sort, terms only
MapReduce: master → parsers (map, a-f g-p q-z)
logarithmic merge: k-th fill = k in binary, O(T log T)
γ 13 = 1110,101 Heaps M = k·T^b, Zipf cf ∝ 1/i
